text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Make Debut? Ah! Are you talking about what
Senpai mentioned, about some amazing girl debuting?"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She'll definitely be a regular in next year's GⅠ races.
I'll be chasing down the "Prodigy," Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At last, the day of her first race in the
Twinkle Series, the Debut race, has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse looks different than when I came as a spectator.
The tension in the air instinctively made me straighten my posture.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...The staff entrance
is this way."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't mind you feeling nervous, but please just don't forget your job.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ah, good morning, Admire Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are wearing an armband.
Looks like a reporter from a sports paper.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text: Hello, fellow Tracen Academy member. I was looking forward to meeting you at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Reporters from every outlet have their eyes on you.
Could we get a word on your aspirations—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There is nothing in particular
that I need to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm... so 'no comment' then?
How about your condition, or anything like that...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Please watch the actual race. If you have any further questions, please direct them to the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have various preparations to attend to, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it... she doesn't really seem like a rookie.
She feels strangely mature, or something...”

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, not bad at all.
She's got the makings of greatness. Make sure you get good shots of her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, Admire Groove is drawing a huge amount of attention.
Everyone wants to see the prodigy's true power with their own eyes."
choice_data_list: They're expecting big things from you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It doesn't particularly matter to me
how the world evaluates me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What I have my sights set on right now is beyond this—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The impending battle in the Classics—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The stage to settle things... with her.
—Only the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: There is no need to be on guard for today's race either.
choice_data_list: Then let's review the key points for today's course—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That won't be necessary.
It's already all in my head.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, what I must do today...
is confirm where I currently stand. That is all.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Isn't that the girl mentioned in the article?
She looks kind of cool...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Standing in the paddock
makes them look like an even bigger deal.
The main race is gonna be quite a show...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(......Pre-race hype is nothing but background noise.
There is only one thing I must focus on—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I will run ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you catch up.
...Not even once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if to drown out the burning expectations around her,
Admire Groove takes her first step,
cloaked in an air as quiet as ice.
